name: Ahmad Shah
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly after a career in the Royal Malaysian Police. His expertise in risk assessment and threat mitigation caught the eye of a local racing team owner seeking to enhance their security protocols. Ahmad quickly adapted his law enforcement skills to the fast-paced world of motorsport, focusing on protecting valuable assets and ensuring the safety of personnel and equipment. 

At Cadillac Racing, Ahmad is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to detail. He believes that a robust security plan is essential not just for preventing theft or sabotage, but also for fostering a safe and focused environment where team members can perform at their best. His dedication to proactive security measures and his calm demeanor under pressure have earned him the respect of the entire team. Ahmad's perfectionist tendencies drive him to continuously refine security procedures and adapt to evolving threats.

physical.description: Ahmad is a man of medium build with a serious but approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down potential security vulnerabilities.
Insists on checking every lock and seal twice before leaving for the day.
Has a habit of speaking in acronyms, a holdover from his police days.
